description: Changes the listing's facts in Property details: price, bedrooms, bathrooms, square feet, listing status (active, coming soon, pending, sold), the listing description or the listing name (what the opening title shows when its wording is listing_name, for example 'Just Listed in Austin'; it is also the listing's own name in Reel-E, so the editor header, the listings list and download file names change with it). It updates the listing itself, the same as the Property details dialog, and the website and the opening title read it. On a listing whose website is live it needs the publish permission (Full control), since the site shows the change at once; without it nothing changes. It puts no text on the video; add_text and set_title do that. Suits 'change the price to 1.2 million', 'it's 4 beds' or 'mark it pending'. Uses no credit; undoable. Addresses are changed in Property details in Keylight. When a number could mean two things (for example 'six-bedroom bathroom count'), the person clarifies first.

baths.description: Whole or half baths, for example 2.5.

beds.description: Number of bedrooms; null clears it.

description.description: The new listing description, up to 4,000 characters.

listingName.description: The listing's name, shown by the opening title when its wording is listing_name. It is also the listing's own name in Reel-E (editor header, listings list, download file names).

marketStatus.description: Listing status: active, coming_soon, pending or sold.

price.description: Listing price in dollars, for example 1200000.

sqft.description: Interior square feet; null clears it.

name: update_property_details
title: Property details
